Name: Saloon sells Loved Dishes
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
[list]
[*]This mod adds NPC's favorite dishes to the Saloon menu. You can choose between having the Loved dishes all year or by the  NPC's birthday season.
[/list]
[b]Version 1.2 Adds dialogue for Gus. He lets you know NPC's birthday and loved dish.  Dialogue is optional.
Example Fall 13: "Buy Abigail some spicy eel so she doesn't just eat rocks.",
You will not get dialogue for Sandy, Kent and Leo until year 2. Scroll down to see all dialogue.[/b]
[list]
[*]Complete Breakfast//Alex 
[*] Tom Kha Soup//Elliott & Penny                
[*] Super Meal//Harvey Sashimi//Sebastian             
[*] SpicyEel//Abigail                 
[*]Survival Burger//Emily                 
[*] Pink Cake//Haley & Jas & Marnie & Vincent               
[*]Cheese Cauliflower//Maru                 
[*]Fish Tacos//Caroline & Gus                  
[*] Bean Hot Pot//Demetrius                  
[*]Glazed Yams//Lewis & Pam
[*]Blueberry Tart//Linus               
[*] Fried Calamari//Pierre                 
[*] Mango Sticky Rice//Sandy              
[*]Fried Mushroom//George               
[*]Chocolate Cake//Jodi & Evelyn   
[*]Fiddlehead Risotto//Kent & Clint     
[*]Poi//Leo  
[*]********
[*]Part of the Saloon's vanilla menu.
[*]Pizza//Sam //Shane
[*]Salad//Leah
[*]Spaghetti //Robin
[*]*****
[*]Dwarf, Willy, Wizard & Krobus do not have a Loved dish.
[/list]
I hope you like this mod and take a look at my other mods including
